This is a talk I gave at the 2013 Caritas & Veritas symposium at Dominican University. It’s about the quest to use technology to control morality, and covers some early attempts in this direction during the gonzo days of deep brain stimulation (Heath and Delgado!). The media lab at DU did some really cool editing for this.
